terms: fal.ai model output; speridlabs/idol/max lists commercial use as supported. Generated for this project; no third-party likeness, brand or logo requested.

steps.prompt: A heavy chubby round slate-blue cartoon bird toy figure standing on two small orange feet, wide barrel body with a pale grey belly patch, short thick orange beak, big round white eyes with dark pupils under stern slanted eyebrows, wearing a dark gunmetal iron aviator helmet with brass rivets, a small golden crest tuft poking out of the helmet top, short tail feathers, smooth rounded sides with NO wings at all, no arms, nothing on the sides of the body. Photograph of a real hand-painted wooden toy: carved and lathe-turned hardwood with smooth satin enamel paint, visible wood grain and soft brush strokes, chunky rounded toy proportions, tilt-shift macro product photography, soft warm daylight. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
